purpose: Money-vs-vanity source of truth. Each term is tagged by intent, buyer-fit, difficulty and the page that should own it. gscPosition is the live Search Console rank where JTE already surfaces (null = not surfacing yet). Feed highBuyerFit money targets to the Content Strategist (what to write) and On-Page SEO (what to optimise). Flag low buyer-fit terms so we do not chase traffic that brings the wrong business.

legend.intent: transactional = ready to act/buy · commercial = comparing providers · informational = researching, top-of-funnel
legend.buyerFit: high = employer-with-budget in our lane · med = adjacent/softer intent · low = vanity or wrong audience
legend.difficulty: rough ranking difficulty for JTE today (low/med/high)
legend.gscPosition: avg Search Console position in last window, null if not surfacing
